description:
TX10 Pro Max Bluetooth calling smartwatch with 1.9" TFT LCD display is built for people who want a big screen, clear wrist calls, and daily health tracking at a budget price. See notifications and caller ID easily on the large 1.9-inch touch display, then answer calls from your wrist when your phone is on the desk or in your bag (up to 10m range). Track sleep, heart rate, blood pressure and SpO2 to stay aware of your routine and recovery, while multi‑sports modes help you stay consistent with walks, runs, and workouts.

Wireless charging keeps it simple—drop it on the charger and power up without fiddling with pins. With an alloy case and IP67 water resistance, it handles sweat, splashes, and daily wear. If you need one watch that keeps you connected, nudges you to move, and makes your day feel organized, TX10 Pro Max delivers.

features: Big 1.9" touchscreen display: Large, easy-to-read screen for messages, caller ID, and quick taps—great for daily use and seniors too.
Bluetooth calling on the wrist: Answer and talk directly from the watch when paired to your phone, so you stay hands-free at home, office, or during walks.
Everyday health tracking: Sleep tracking plus heart rate, blood pressure and SpO2 monitoring to help you notice patterns and stay consistent (not a medical device).
Multi‑sports modes: Track common activities like walking, running and workout sessions to build routine and motivation.
Smart notifications: Get alerts for calls, messages and apps so you check your phone less and stay focused.
Wireless charging convenience: Simple drop-and-charge power with the included wireless charger—no fragile charging pins.
Stable 10‑meter range (Bluetooth 5.0): Keeps you connected when your phone is across the room or on a desk.
IP67 water resistance + alloy case: Handles sweat and splashes for gym and daily wear, with a durable metal-look build.
Android & iOS support: Works with Android 5.0+ and iOS 9.0+ for broad compatibility.
